Official Address

Welcome Message from the Head of Department

"Welcome to the Department of Commerce at University of Loralai! We are thrilled to introduce you to our dynamic and forward-thinking academic community, dedicated to nurturing future business leaders and professionals. As the Head of the Department of Commerce, I take great pride in the excellence of our faculty and the comprehensive program we offer. Our goal is to provide a holistic education that equips you with not only theoretical knowledge but also practical skills and real-world experience. Here at Department of Commerce, we believe in fostering an inclusive learning environment that encourages innovation, critical thinking, and ethical decision-making. Our diverse faculty members are experts in their respective fields, and they are committed to supporting your academic journey and personal growth. Choosing the right institution is a significant decision, and we understand the importance of finding the best fit for your educational journey. We invite you to explore our prospectus thoroughly and visit our campus to experience the vibrant academic atmosphere we offer. Join us at the Department of Commerce, and together, let's embark on a transformative journey. Mr. Adnan Ahmad Khan Chairperson, Department of Commerce University of Loralai Faculty Adnan Ahmad Khan"

Adnan Ahmad Khan

Chairperson Department of Commerce

Strategic Direction

Department Vision

To be the business school of Commerce for students, employers, businesses and stakeholders, that may lead to overcome the cutting-edge challenges of the contemporary business world. 🎯

Core Commitment

Department Mission

In pursuit of excellence, offering innovative programs and high quality teaching in the field of commerce to prepare intellects with the competencies to offer practical solutions to industrial challenges. To prepare novel researchers adding conspicuous share in the globalization of the business world. ⭐

Department Core Values

IntegrityCompassionQuality and ContinuityStudents learning and developmentTo prepare students for career in research and training institutions.To undertake research on emerging issues in public and private enterprise.
